Executive Summary

A selection of HumbleBeeAI computer vision projects spanning retail, healthcare, sports, and agriculture. The entries below retain the reported outcomes and qualifications, including cases where results are qualitative or clinical validation remains pending.
Selected projects
Shelf Analysis AI platform for Retail Compliance

Automated product detection and shelf-position analysis integrated into a retail distribution platform; reported 90%+ detection accuracy and 80% less manual audit time within the first month across 500+ locations.

attrs.chunkText: A leading retail technology company, provider of a comprehensive cloud SaaS platform for distribution, partnered with HumbleBeeAI to revolutionize retail compliance monitoring for their 600+ customers across FMCG, beverage, pharmaceutical, and automotive industries. Through our comprehensive Shelf Analysis AI platform integrated into their distribution platform, we delivered automated product detection and intelligent shelf positioning analysis across 500+ locations. The solution achieved 90%+ detection accuracy, reduced manual audit time by 80% within the first month, resulting in enhanced brand visibility and increased sales performance for their end clients.

A Global Beverage Leader Prevents Retail Fraud with AI

AI fraud detection integrated with retail field-reporting and planogram workflows; the source reports over 90% fraudulent-submission detection accuracy in the first week and more than 90% improvement in audit reliability.

attrs.chunkText:
The implementation of HumbleBeeAI's anti-fraud AI solution delivered immediate and transformative results, fundamentally solving a challenge that was previously impossible to manage at scale.

Fraudulent submissions were detected with over 90% accuracy within the first week, increasing overall audit reliability by more than 90% and restoring integrity to the field reporting process.

The system's ability to process a massive volume of image inputs from thousands of locations automated an unfeasible task to evaluate manually, ensuring consistent visual merchandising across the entire retail network.

By providing clean, validated data, the platform enabled the company to make data-driven decisions, leading to optimized merchandising strategies, stronger retail partnerships, and maximized return on investment.

A leading retail technology company, provider of a comprehensive cloud SaaS platform for distribution, transformed retail compliance monitoring for their 600+ customers by partnering with HumbleBeeAI. By implementing an AI-powered fraud detection system into their platform, the company now enables their clients - including distributors and manufacturers across FMCG, beverage, pharmaceutical, and automotive industries - to eliminate fraudulent reporting from field agents, ensure planogram adherence across thousands of locations, and achieve high accuracy in retail audits.

Flexible Campaigns with Poster Recognition AI

Poster recognition with instant reference-database updates replaced a previous three-month retraining cycle; reported results include 94% recognition accuracy, 90% less verification time, and 85% lower deployment costs.

attrs.chunkText: A leading retail technology company, provider of a comprehensive distribution platform, transformed poster recognition capabilities for their retail clients by integrating HumbleBeeAI's advanced Computer Vision solution. The integration eliminated traditional model limitations and achieved campaign flexibility, replacing costly 3-month retraining cycles with instant poster database updates, reducing deployment costs by 85%, and enabling real-time promotional campaign adaptability across 500+ retail locations.

Boosting Recognition Accuracy with AI-Powered Data Refinement

Image filtering, track-level identity aggregation, and security checks addressed unusable face images and fragmented attendance records; approximately 5,000 unusable images daily describes the earlier problem, not a measured post-deployment reduction.

attrs.chunkText:
HumbleBee AI implemented a multi-faceted, AI-driven solution designed to systematically address each of the client's challenges. Our approach focused on enhancing data processing, improving recognition logic, and fortifying system security.

Intelligent Image Filtering and Categorization: To tackle poor data quality, we developed a sophisticated filtering mechanism. The system now analyzes facial landmarks to assess image viability, automatically discarding unusable frames based on predefined parameters like a minimum face size of 640 pixels and frontal positioning. For security, we integrated person-tracking AI. If a tracked individual's face is not detectable (e.g., due to a mask), the system flags them as an unauthorized person and alerts management, ensuring security is maintained.

Advanced Face Tracking for Recognition: To eliminate misrecognition, we integrated facial tracking technology. Instead of analyzing each frame in isolation, the system now tracks an individual across multiple frames. How Retail AI solutions provider boosted accuracy by 20% with R&D
Focused computer vision R&D improved cart and varied-item detection from approximately 55% to 75% mAP@50–95 (about 20 percentage points), with real-time performance on edge devices.

attrs.chunkText: A European retail technology company specializing in intelligent checkout and loss prevention systems faced major challenges in accurately detecting shopping carts and items during checkout. Partnering with HumbleBeeAI, they improved a custom Computer Vision system reaching from ~55% to ~75% accuracy on mAP@50-95, one of the most demanding and comprehensive performance metrics. Through focused R&D, the team overcame the low accuracy of detecting the 'items' - a category encompassing all purchasable goods of varied shapes, sizes, and colors - resulting in a highly robust and reliable detection framework that improved operational efficiency and loss prevention accuracy.
